verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents programmatic usage export through the FOCUS API, currently in Public Preview. Billing insights show consumption breakdowns by resource type, and a Managed Grafana Cost and Usage zone is also available. Nothing in the evidence shows spend attributed by team, workload, cluster, or label, and the API is still preview. Missing for 10: documented attribution by team/workload (tags, labels, or cost allocation), FOCUS API schema and depth, GA status, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can pull usage and billing breakdowns programmatically to attribute GPU spend by team or workload

citations.quote: You can also export usage programmatically with the FOCUS API (Public Preview), or find your usage and costs in the Managed Grafana Cost and Usage product zone.
Billing insights: View billable resource usage and consumption breakdowns by resource type.
